author: Microsoft
description:
Economist and public thinker Tyler Cowen joins host Molly Wood to break down why AI adoption and what it means for the future of work are so challenging for many employees, leaders, businesses, and universities.
 
Cowen discusses how AI is reshaping jobs, productivity, skills, why organizations struggle to adapt, and what leaders can expect as they push their organizations to reinvent how they operate and create value with AI.

title: How to adapt to change at work without losing your edge | Insights from economist Tyler Cowen
